notes: This release packages the v0.5 framework contract: Python remains a mechanical renderer/validator while the host LLM owns syllabus judgment, concept writing, visual need, and final review.
Every topic must carry a Writer-owned visual_decision with one of text-ok, exact-svg, kroki-diagram, or external-infographic. text-ok requires no_visual_reason.
This is not a blanket final-ready certification for all boards, levels, subjects, or visual routes. Output-specific evidence is still required before any route is promoted above candidate.

release_changes.python_role: mechanical execution only: official source fetch, page text extraction, JSON receipt/validation, rendering, PDF export, asset import, and packaging
release_changes.llm_role: syllabus boundaries, exam-point selection, concept explanations, worked examples, per-topic visual_decision, and visible-handbook review
release_changes.workflow_role_model: Analyst, Writer, and Reviewer are lightweight operating roles, not mandatory separate agents
release_changes.visual_policy: Every topic needs visual_decision; text-ok requires no_visual_reason; non-text routes require visual_spec and reviewed rendered assets before final delivery

entries.scope_warning: Candidate framework evidence only. Do not describe any generated handbook as final-ready unless its own validation, visual, product-review, and release-evidence artifacts say so.
